evidence: In 2023, the company enhanced its Vetscan Imagyst platform by adding artificial intelligence (AI) dermatology and AI fecal for equine, which uses a combination of image recognition technology, algorithms and cloud-based AI to deliver rapid testing results to veterinary clinics.

In 2024, the company added AI urine sediment analysis to the Vetscan Imagyst platform and launched Vetscan OptiCell a cartridge-based, AI powered hematology analyzer that provides advanced Complete Blood Count (CBC) analysis.
In 2025, the company added AI Masses, which detects potentially neoplastic cells, to the Vetscan Imagyst platform.
We incorporate (and expect to continue incorporating) the use of AI in our operations.
We incorporate (and expect to continue incorporating) AI capabilities in the development of new technologies and products and continue to expand the use of AI in our business and operations.
ai_positioning.summary: Zoetis (santé animale) intègre l'IA dans ses plateformes de diagnostic vétérinaire (Vetscan Imagyst) et dans la R&D pharmaceutique (découverte molécules, optimisation essais cliniques), sans positionnement IA comme axe de communication financière central.
